value.name: Leon reviews script quietly
value.description: The next morning, Leon sits in the green room reviewing his script while Oscar reads separately, establishing a subdued atmosphere after prior events.
evidence: Next morning. The green room is quieter. Leon sits at a makeup station reviewing his script. Oscar reads in the corner.

value.name: Diana clears Leon for movement
value.description: Diana informs Leon that the stage physician has cleared him for full movement, while warning him to stop if he feels pain.
evidence: DIANA enters, consulting a BLUE CLIPBOARD. She sets it on the table and turns to Leon.

DIANA
Leon. The stage physician cleared you for full movement. Any pain, you stop.

value.name: Leon explains his injury
value.description: Leon claims his injury came from a car accident caused by another driver running a red light and minimizes it as a fluke affecting only his arm.
evidence:
LEON
Understood. Honestly, the whole thing was a fluke. I was in a car accident -- the other driver ran a red light. Lucky it was just the arm.

value.name: Diana records Leon's status
value.description: Diana responds tersely and writes notes on her blue clipboard, indicating she is formally documenting Leon's condition and remarks.
evidence: She makes a note on the blue clipboard.

value.name: Oscar challenges Leon's story
value.description: Without looking up, Oscar contradicts Leon's account by saying he thought the injury involved a ladder, casting doubt on Leon's explanation.
evidence:
OSCAR
(not looking up)
Car accident. I thought it was the ladder.

value.name: Oscar implies Leon is lying
value.description: After Leon dismisses the importance of the cause, Oscar says only the story matters, implying Leon is shaping a false narrative about his injury.
evidence:
OSCAR
Not to the production. Only to the story you tell.

value.name: Leon falls silent under scrutiny
value.description: Leon offers no response to Oscar's pointed remark, signaling discomfort or concealment as Diana notices the tension and continues marking her clipboard.
evidence: Leon says nothing. Diana glances between them and marks something else on the blue clipboard.

value.name: Diana calls company to stage
value.description: Diana directs the full company to be on stage in thirty minutes and demands a clean Act One, shifting the scene back to production discipline.
evidence:
DIANA
Full company on stage in thirty minutes. I want Act One clean.
